decisions.reason: As a simple accessory closely linked to the firm's existing trailer and service knowledge, it is easy to absorb and support, but its lower strategic importance makes rationalisation more plausible than for core trailer lines.
This box car trailer series remains very close to the firm's core manufacturing, sales and service capabilities, so management would be more likely to refine and extend it than withdraw it.

The low-bed trailer series fits the firm's established hauling know-how and customer base well, giving it strong scope for learning and improvement through existing production and development capabilities.
